name: Tattletales
overview: Scripture warns against being a talebearer or tattletale, emphasizing the harm caused by spreading accusations without proper evidence, as seen in Leviticus 19:16 and Deuteronomy 19:15. Believers are instructed to address faults privately and lovingly, as Matthew 18:15 teaches, rather than exposing others to unnecessary shame. Proverbs 30:10 cautions against injuring others with careless words, highlighting the importance of guarding our speech. As children of light, Christians are called to walk in integrity and love, avoiding the darkness of harmful gossip (Ephesians 5:8).
